excludeCategories.description: Skip businesses whose category contains any of these words, for example ["hotel", "casino"].
excludeCategories.title: Exclude categories

hasPhone.description: Only keep businesses that publish a phone number on their Google Maps listing.
hasPhone.title: Must have a phone number

hasWebsite.description: Only keep businesses that publish a website on their Google Maps listing.
hasWebsite.title: Must have a website

includeClosed.description: When off, businesses Google marks as permanently closed are skipped.
includeClosed.title: Include permanently closed businesses

language.description: Language for Google Maps interface and results.
language.title: Language

location.description: Optional location to append to the search query (e.g., 'Los Angeles, CA'). Leave blank if location is already in the search query.
location.title: Location (optional)

locations.description: Run the search in several places in one go, e.g. ["New York, NY", "Austin, TX"]. Used with mode = search. Each term is searched in each location.
locations.title: Locations (batch)

maxRating.description: Only keep businesses rated at or below this value. Useful for finding under-served or low-rated prospects.
maxRating.title: Maximum rating

maxResults.description: Requested number of places to collect **per search**. With a batch of search terms or locations, every search gets its own allowance, so one busy term cannot use up the others. Records stop when the public feed ends, this ceiling is reached for that search, or the bounded runtime deadline expires.
maxResults.title: Max Results

maxReviews.description: Only keep businesses with at most this many reviews. Useful for finding smaller independent businesses.
maxReviews.title: Maximum review count

minRating.description: Only keep businesses rated at or above this value. Leave empty to keep every rating. A business with no published rating does not satisfy a minimum, so it is skipped.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviews.description: Only keep businesses with at least this many reviews. Use it to filter out brand-new listings with almost no history.
minReviews.title: Minimum review count

mode.description: Search mode uses a text query; placeUrls mode scrapes specific Maps URLs; placeIds mode resolves canonical ChIJ Place IDs through Google's public URL API.
mode.title: Mode

nameFilter.description: Only keep businesses whose name contains this text, for example "pizza" or "Starbucks".
nameFilter.title: Business name contains

openNow.description: Only keep businesses Google currently shows as open.
openNow.title: Open now only

placeIds.description: Canonical Google Place IDs beginning with ChIJ. The actor resolves them anonymously through Google's public Maps URL API.
placeIds.title: Google Place IDs

placeUrls.description: List of Google Maps place URLs to scrape directly. Used when mode is 'placeUrls'. Each URL should be a full Google Maps place URL.
placeUrls.title: Place URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for the scraper. Using Apify Proxy is recommended for reliable results.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

searchQuery.description: What to search for on Google Maps. Include location in the query for best results (e.g., 'coffee shop in New York'). Used when mode is 'search'.
searchQuery.title: Search Query

searchTerms.description: Run several search terms in one go, e.g. ["coffee shops", "dentists"]. Used with mode = search. Each term is searched in every location you provide, and every search gets its own maxResults allowance.
searchTerms.title: Search terms (batch)
